BOH Eastern Waste Service Subcommittee.text: Subcomité de Servicio de Residuos del Este de la Junta de Salud
BOH Eastern Waste Service Subcommittee.check: review: Mistranslation: "Eastern Waste Service" is the name of a service or company. The translation turns it into "Servicio de Residuos del Este" and loses the word "Eastern" as part of a name. It also reads as if the subcommittee covers waste service in the eastern area. The translation also expands "BOH" to "Junta de Salud" and moves it to the end, which is acceptable, but the name is changed.
